description: Client-side JavaScript code for user interface interactions in the vtiger CRM module 'Users'. Includes functions for updating widgets, managing form elements, and handling UI toggles.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets report-to user information in the parent window.

methods.name: updateWidgetWindow
methods.description: Updates the widget content area based on selected heading, toggling iframe and form element states.

methods.name: saveWidget
methods.description: Validates that an image is uploaded when 'Company-Logo' is selected.

methods.name: checkB4Submit
methods.description: Displays an alert and returns true; placeholder for pre-submit validation.

methods.name: updateWidgets
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to update widget list and refresh display.

methods.name: showhide
methods.description: Toggles visibility of UI layers and updates toggle symbols.

methods.name: closeWindow
methods.description: Closes current window and reloads opener.

methods.name: manageWidgets
methods.description: Handles widget enable/disable via AJAX based on checkbox state.
